rows.title: Formal response arrives before usable recovery

backtest_plan.holdout: later case or release after the source observation period
backtest_plan.outcome: receipt, usable recovery, durable access, and exit after formal response
backtest_plan.required_evidence: dated comparable cases with the same response, implementation, receipt, recovery, and exit stages

rows.next_action: Code formal response, implementation, receipt, durable access, and exit stages across independent labor, consumer, health, and public-service records.

rows.title: Time and financial pressure reduce practical room before demand disappears

backtest_plan.holdout: later survey wave or geography held out from candidate construction
backtest_plan.outcome: time pressure, participation, substitution, or delayed completion using compatible denominators
backtest_plan.required_evidence: at least two comparable waves or places with common unit, population, and participation measure

rows.next_action: Preserve compatible time, cost, participation, and wellbeing units before interpreting practical-room change.

rows.title: Digital capability expands while control and trust remain contested

backtest_plan.holdout: later attitude, adoption, or control-measure release
backtest_plan.outcome: capability adoption alongside verification, contestability, remedy, or trust
backtest_plan.required_evidence: repeated independent measures separating capability from control and trust

rows.next_action: Separate efficiency, delegation, trust, control, recourse, retention, and exit measures.

rows.title: Infrastructure dependency becomes cultural and geopolitical power

backtest_plan.holdout: later operating or disruption window after the candidate period
backtest_plan.outcome: operation followed by reliability, tariff, bill, compensation, or acceptance outcome
backtest_plan.required_evidence: dated event and outcome records linked by compatible geography and system unit

rows.next_action: Link capacity or ownership claims to operation, actual receipt, local burden, maintenance, and acceptance.

boundary: This matrix is conservative: absent evidence is a failed gate, not an inferred pass. A qualified candidate is not automatically a qualified trend or an internal company finding. A backtest plan is not a backtest result.
